facts.fact: The Smart City Rwanda Masterplan, developed in 2017, says plans are underway to establish the Kigali Innovation City, an innovation park on the outskirts of Kigali linked to academia, government and industry.

note: The masterplan names Impact Hub and The Office as existing co-working spaces in Kigali with no programme stated; its co-working and excellence-centre initiative for secondary cities is a recommendation.
